validity.researcher_notes: A real proposal, never built: Japanese proposals in 2014 and 2017 (Nikkei, Caspian Barrel) and Gazprom's 2021 statement that it is not considering it. Length differs by source (1,500 km to Kanto, 1,350 km to Ibaraki), so the sheet figure is a design estimate. Reuters 2014 and the JPDO history page were only available as Wayback copies, see ledger.

fills.researcher_notes: Vedomosti, 20 May 2021: Gazprom deputy chair Elena Burmistrova said the company is not considering a pipeline to Japan and can supply Japan with LNG instead. The page says 'gas pipeline to Japan' and does not use the name Sakhalin-Hokkaido, so name match is by description. One publisher, medium. Read via fetch.py. Already a ref on the sheet.

Read through the page's embedded article data via fetch.py. Already a ref on the sheet. A 2014 Caspian Barrel page gives 1,350 km to Ibaraki, a different design.
